name: ai-multi-agent-ctrl
description: AI-native multi-agent control plane specs and local management console.

scripts.validate: ruby scripts/validate-specs.rb && npm run contract:check && npm run -s auth-placement-gate && npm run -s barrier-liveness-gate && npm run -s console-behaviour-gate && npm run -s human-only-parity-gate && npm run -s system-invariants-gate && npm run -s crash-consistency-gate && npm run -s concurrent-writer-gate && npm run -s idle-tick-gate
scripts.doctor: npm run validate && node scripts/run-with-env.mjs scripts/doctor.mjs && npm run mcp:doctor && npm run agent:doctor && npm run docker:doctor && npm run -s mutation-gate
scripts.mutation-gate:one: AIMAC_MUTATION_ONLY="${AIMAC_MUTATION_ONLY:?用法：AIMAC_MUTATION_ONLY='名字片段' npm run mutation-gate:one}" node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs
